title: AI Compute Extensions (ACE) Specification
summary: This is a technical specification document for AI Compute Extensions (ACE) on the x86 architecture, defining a standardized set of hardware extensions designed to accelerate AI and machine learning workloads directly in silicon. The specification aims to provide a unified framework for implementing AI-specific instructions and capabilities in x86 processors.
problem_solved: Standardizes AI compute capabilities across x86 platforms, enabling consistent hardware-level AI acceleration without relying solely on external accelerators.
why_valuable: Provides a vendor-neutral specification for integrating AI computation directly into x86 CPUs, potentially democratizing AI hardware acceleration across the PC and server ecosystem.
